title: Mordheim KB editorial documents — shared definitions
description: Pieces shared by the band packages (`band.yaml`, `profiles.yaml`, `equipment-access.yaml`, `special-rules.yaml`), by the hireling catalogue (`catalog/hirelings/`) and by the campaign catalogue (`catalog/campaign/`). The document schemas reference this file with a relative $ref; `mordheim_knowledge.editorial_schemas` merges the definitions before validating, so no external registry is needed at run time. The runtime block mirrors `sources/knowledge/registry/runtime-schema.yaml` and is also enforced at load time by `mordheim_knowledge.loader.validate_rule_runtime`.

id.description: Stable KB identifier: lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens. IDs are never renamed — semantic scenarios pin sources by id and content digest, and campaign files reference stable KB ids only.

rule_id.description: Rule id of the `<owner>--<name>` grammar, where <owner> is the band, a profile id or a shared-rule id.

display_text.description: Human-readable text: names, prose and section labels.

i18n.description: Translations only. English is canonical and stored once in `name` / `effect`; an `en` mirror is forbidden and `tools/knowledge/maintenance/normalize_names.py` strips a locale block left without a real translation.

es.description: Reviewed Spanish translation of the canonical English name or effect.

characteristic_name.description: Characteristic key of the Mordheim profile line, declared once for the profile line, the characteristic map and the bindings that name a characteristic.

characteristic_value.description: Characteristic value: a number, null when the creature has none, or a dice expression such as `2D6` when the profile rolls for it.

characteristic_map.description: Complete characteristic line: every characteristic is declared, even when its value is null.

source_ref.description: Editorial provenance of a record: which printed manual or web page it was transcribed from, and where in it.

manual.description: Where the text comes from: normally a registered source id (`mordheimer.net`, `chaos-in-the-streets`, `lustria`, `khemri`, `trollheim`, `user-ruling` …); a few rules-catalogue records still carry the printed manual name (`Mordheim Rulebook`) instead.

printed_page.description: Page of the printed manual, or 0 when the record comes from a web page. Ranges such as `74-80` travel as text.

section.description: Section, heading or table the record was read from.

url.description: Canonical location of the source page, when it has one.

source_refs.description: Editorial provenance of a catalogue record: one entry per source it was transcribed from. An empty list means the provenance has not been collated yet.

catalog_status.description: Editorial lifecycle of a catalogue document. `published` is real, source-referenced data; `draft` marks rules that are still unconfirmed, as `docs/guides/campaign-knowledge.md` prescribes instead of inventing data.

dice.description: A dice pool: how many dice of how many sides, with the optional flat modifier and multiplier the campaign tables use for expressions such as `2D6+1` or `D6 x 25`.

sides.description: Faces of each die: 3 or 6 in the campaign tables, 6 in the duel tables.

modifier.description: Flat amount added to the total, e.g. `2D6+1`.

multiplier.description: Amount the total is multiplied by, e.g. `D6 x 25 gc`.

interval.description: Inclusive interval a roll falls in. `min` is always declared; `max` is omitted only when the branch is open-ended (the last cell of a chart, e.g. `36+`).

min.description: Lowest roll of the interval, inclusive.

max.description: Highest roll of the interval, inclusive. Omitted when the interval is open-ended.

amount.description: A quantity of a resource: a fixed number or a dice expression. `kind` says which of the two the record carries, so a cancelled or deferred amount is never written as a magic zero.

kind.description: `fixed` for a number, `dice` for a rolled amount.

value.description: The fixed quantity, in whole units of the resource.

dice.description: The dice expression rolled for the quantity.

multiplier.description: Amount the rolled quantity is multiplied by, for expressions such as `D6 x 10`.

offset.description: Amount added to the rolled quantity, for expressions such as `D6+1` the source prints outside the dice.

id_or_parameter.description: A stable KB id, or a `$parameter` the procedure binds at run time (`$requested_item_id`, `$searching_hero` …). A parameter is not an id: it is resolved from the caller's context and never names a catalogue record.

id_list.description: List of stable KB ids of the same kind (band ids, group ids, rule ids …). Order is not significant.

runtime_scope.description: Runtime scope the document belongs to. Today the duel runtime is one-against-one close combat only; widening it is a contract change.

runtime_binding.description: The executable link of an effect: equivalence between rules is declared by sharing `kind` + `id` (+ `parameters`) and is never inferred from names or prose.

kind.description: `mechanic` and `trait` are shared executable contracts; `profile` is construction data already normalized in `profiles.yaml`; `compiler` is transitional.

id.description: Stable id of the bound mechanic, trait, profile binding or compiler contract.

parameters.description: Binding parameters that complete the executable link. The vocabulary below is the one the knowledge base uses; the numbers themselves live in the band rule.

allowed_skill_lists.description: Skill tables a granted access extends.

categories.description: Item or rule categories the binding covers.

characteristics.description: Characteristics the binding is about. Its values are the profile line's, declared once in `characteristic_name`.

forbids.description: Item, category or rule id the binding forbids.

ignore_penalties.description: Whether the binding cancels the usual penalties.

value.description: Magnitude of the binding: a characteristic value or a flag.

runtime_effect.description: One classified effect of a rule. Every effect declares its scope and either an executable binding or the reason it has none.

id.description: Stable effect id: a shared mechanic id or an `unimplemented.<band>.<profile>.<slug>` placeholder.

scope.description: `YES` belongs to the current duel runtime; `LATER` is a deferred subsystem; `NO` is out of scope.

binding.description: The executable link, or null when the effect has none.

reason.description: Required whenever there is no binding: the audit taxonomy such as `Deferred subsystem: psychology.` or `Out of scope: shooting.`.

rule_runtime.description: Runtime classification of a rule. A rule without this block is unclassified, not implemented.

scope.description: Widest scope over the rule's effects.

implemented.description: `YES` only when every `YES` effect has an executable binding.

grant.description: `profile` and `band` are inherent; `selectable` is chosen in play and then declares `kind`; `none` grants nothing by itself.
